summary: Learn to implement ISO/IEC 42001 with practical AIMS tools, risk controls, and audit-ready templates. Enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: ISO/IEC 42001 implementation training helps AI governance, risk, compliance, and assurance professionals establish an AI management system (AIMS). Through practical exercises, participants define AIMS scope and policy, assess AI risks, and select controls across the AI lifecycle. They also develop impact-assessment workflows, prepare documented evidence, and create internal audit plans and management-review reporting for implementation in existing governance workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to implement ISO/IEC 42001 inside live governance, risk, compliance, or assurance workflows. It is suitable for people who already work with AI oversight, management systems, audit evidence, or information risk and need a practical route into AIMS implementation.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of organisational risk management, governance processes, and basic AI use cases. Familiarity with ISO management system structures such as ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001, or ISO 31000 is helpful but not mandatory. No coding or programming is required for completion, and advanced AI concepts are taught at an operational implementation level focused on governance, controls, and evidence. You should bring a laptop for document-based exercises, and prepared examples of your organisation’s AI use cases, policies, or risk notes if available.
